title: Fenchel-Willmore-Chen inequality under lower bounds on weighted intermediate Ricci curvature
summary: We establish a Fenchel-Willmore-Chen inequality for smooth metric measure spaces with a lower bound on the 1-Bakry-Emery k-Ricci curvature. This extends previous results and yields a unified proof. In addition, a Sobolev and isoperimetric inequality for nonnegative 1-weighted Ricci curvature is proven.
